summary: The MaintTemplates ASP.NET web page is designed for managing templates in the HSPnet system. It involves displaying, adding, editing, and deleting template entries using a grid-based interface.
purpose: The file serves as a user interface for maintaining templates, allowing users to perform CRUD operations (Create, Read, Update, Delete) on template data within the HSPnet application.

workflows.name: Handling Template Records
steps: Load the page and initialize the UserSession.
If the page is accessed for the first time, refresh data and set focus on the txtKeyword field.
Allow users to add a new template through the cmdAdd command.
Enable editing of templates through the cmdEdit command, populating details for editing.
Enable deletion of templates through the cmdDelete command.
Save changes to templates using the cmdSave command; if the ID is zero, add a new record, otherwise update the existing record.
Hide details and refresh the grid data after operations.

system_behavior: Uses ASP.NET controls and AjaxControlToolkit for user interaction and UI updates.
Refreshes data whenever the cmdRefreshView button is clicked.
